schema:
CREATE TABLE olist_category_translation (
	product_category_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	product_category_name_english VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (product_category_name)
)
CREATE TABLE olist_customers (
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_unique_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_zip_code_prefix INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_city VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	customer_state VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id)
)
CREATE TABLE olist_order_items (
	order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	order_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	seller_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	shipping_limit_date DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	freight_value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (order_id, order_item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES olist_orders (order_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES olist_products (product_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(seller_id) REFERENCES olist_sellers (seller_id)
)
CREATE TABLE olist_order_payments (
	order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payment_sequential INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payment_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payment_installments INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payment_value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (order_id, payment_sequential), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES olist_orders (order_id)
)
CREATE TABLE olist_order_reviews (
	review_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	review_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	review_comment_title TEXT, 
	review_comment_message TEXT, 
	review_creation_date DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	review_answer_timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (review_id, order_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES olist_orders (order_id)
)
CREATE TABLE olist_orders (
	order_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	order_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	order_purchase_timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	order_approved_at DATETIME, 
	order_delivered_carrier_date DATETIME, 
	order_delivered_customer_date DATETIME, 
	order_estimated_delivery_date DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (order_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES olist_customers (customer_id)
)
CREATE TABLE olist_products (
	product_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	product_category_name VARCHAR(128), 
	product_name_length INTEGER, 
	product_description_length INTEGER, 
	product_photos_qty INTEGER, 
	product_weight_g FLOAT, 
	product_length_cm FLOAT, 
	product_height_cm FLOAT, 
	product_width_cm FLOAT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (product_id)
)
CREATE TABLE olist_sellers (
	seller_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	seller_zip_code_prefix INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	seller_city VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	seller_state VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (seller_id)
)

cases.question: 按下单时间 [2018-07-01,2018-08-01)、已交付订单，统计商品金额（不含运费）和有商品记录的订单去重数。结果每行依次为[金额,订单数]；金额保留两位，空集合金额保持NULL，订单数为0。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price),2),COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'
cases.alternate_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(price) amount FROM olist_order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(x.amount),2),COUNT(*) FROM olist_orders o JOIN x ON x.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'

cases.question: 2018年7月已交付、同时有商品和支付记录的订单去重数。可以原始关联这两张明细，但只数不同订单、不累计金额。每行输出[订单数]。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'
cases.alternate_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_orders o WHERE order_status='delivered' AND substr(order_purchase_timestamp,1,7)='2018-07' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM olist_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM olist_order_payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id)

cases.question: 统计2018年7月下单的已交付订单，按支付方式汇总支付金额，金额保留两位，按payment_type升序，每行[支付方式,支付金额]。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.payment_type,ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM olist_order_payments p JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7)='2018-07' GROUP BY p.payment_type ORDER BY p.payment_type
cases.alternate_sql: WITH p AS(SELECT order_id,payment_type,SUM(payment_value) amount FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id,payment_type) SELECT p.payment_type,ROUND(SUM(p.amount),2) FROM p JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01' GROUP BY p.payment_type ORDER BY p.payment_type

cases.question: 2018年7月已交付订单，按客户收货州统计SP与RJ的商品金额（不含运费），保留两位，州升序。每行[州,金额]。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_state,ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7)='2018-07' AND c.customer_state IN('SP','RJ') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state
cases.alternate_sql: SELECT c.customer_state,ROUND(SUM((SELECT SUM(i.price) FROM olist_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)),2) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01' AND c.customer_state IN('SP','RJ') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state

cases.question: 2018年7月已交付且有商品明细的订单，计算商品金额客单价（不含运费），总商品金额除以订单去重数，保留两位。每行[客单价]。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7)='2018-07'
cases.alternate_sql: WITH i AS(SELECT order_id,SUM(price) amount FROM olist_order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.amount),2) FROM i JOIN olist_orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'

cases.question: 2018年7月已交付、有商品和支付记录、支付合计大于0的订单，按每笔支付额占该订单支付总额的比例分摊商品金额，再汇总全部分摊额。这里明确允许按订单内支付比例分摊；每行[分摊总金额]，保留两位。
cases.reference_sql: WITH p AS(SELECT order_id,SUM(payment_value) total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7)='2018-07' AND p.total>0
cases.alternate_sql: WITH pt AS(SELECT order_id,SUM(payment_value) total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price*p.payment_value/pt.total),2) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN pt ON pt.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01' AND pt.total>0
